# grepr_sumo_integration (Resource)

Manages a Sumo Logic integration. Secrets are written through dedicated endpoints after the integration is saved. They are sensitive but stored in Terraform state. They are write-only: the API never returns them, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Removing a secret from the configuration stops managing it without deleting it remotely. If a secret is rejected while the integration is being created, Terraform marks the integration tainted; run `terraform untaint` and apply again to retry the secret without replacing the integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "sumo_collector_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "grepr_sumo_integration" "main" {
  name     = "production_sumo"
  endpoint = var.sumo_collector_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name.

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String, Sensitive) HTTP collector URL. It embeds the collector's secret code, so it is handled as a secret; the server validates its format.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Team IDs with access. Omit to keep the current teams; an empty set clears them.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization owning the integration.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Integration version used for optimistic locking.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import grepr_sumo_integration.main INTEGRATION_ID
```
